title.zh: 关税（货物移出许可证）命令
title.vi: Lệnh Hải quan (Giấy phép Di chuyển Hàng hóa)
title.th: คำสั่งศุลกากร (ใบอนุญาตเคลื่อนย้ายสินค้า)

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Order may be cited as the Customs (Permits to Remove Goods) Order.

2. For the purposes of section 34(2) of the Act, no permit shall be required for the removal of goods if the goods are —
(a)dutiable goods (other than intoxicating liquors or tobacco) the duty on which does not exceed $300;
(b)intoxicating liquors of any type and of an amount not exceeding 10 litres in total;
(c)tobacco of any type and of an amount not exceeding 0.4 kilogrammes in total; and
(d)motor fuel of an amount not exceeding 10 litres in a spare container of a motor vehicle.
[G.N. No. S 148/2003]
[S 185/2019 wef 01/04/2019]
